Jordan (Support): Sorry to ping team — ACME reported model started emitting incorrect tool calls after last night's release. They say the function invocation has swapped fields.
Alex R.: Can you paste the customer's example payload?
Jordan (Support): Sure. From customer logs:
```
{ 'tool': 'order_service.create_order', 'args': { 'item_id': '42', 'quantity': 3 } }
```
But when they run through our API the executed tool receives:
```
{ 'item_id': '3', 'quantity': '42' }
```
So types also flipped.
Emily (Eng Runtime): Interesting. Were they on dedicated or hosted?
Jordan (Support): Hosted (region-us-west). Used model variant rwd-v1.2.1 released yesterday 23:00 UTC.
Chris M.: Any recent kernel or serialization changes? I pushed a small fix to the tool-serialization layer in that release.
Emily (Eng Runtime): Yes, there was a change in how we serialize positional vs named args for fn-calls to optimize tokenization. Might have introduced index shift. :thinking:
Jordan (Support): Customer says incident started right after they saw a canary rolled to their account.
Alex R.: Can we repro locally? Jordan — can you provide the exact API call + headers (redact keys)?
Jordan (Support): Sent example to #incidents DM. Key pieces: prompt includes function schema (params with types). They call via /v1/chat/completions with tool_call enabled and content length ~1200.
Chris M.: Trying a quick repro with current master build... (5m)
OpsBot: Deploy rwd-v1.2.1 rolled to hosted-us-west at 2025-11-12T23:02Z
Chris M.: I can reproduce swap when using greedy decoding + cached KV with beam_size 1. If I disable the positional->named conversion it goes away.
Emily (Eng Runtime): That points at the post-processing routine that maps tokens to arg positions. There's a race if two adjacent args have same token boundary.
Alex R.: Could be an off-by-one when splitting on commas for argument inference.
Jordan (Support): Customer is stuck in prod, asks for mitigation now.
Emily (Eng Runtime): Mitigation: pin their tenant to rwd-v1.2.0 or enable 'strict_fn_schema' in the API which forces named arg parsing. Both are quick.
Jordan (Support): Sent both options. Customer pinned to rwd-v1.2.0 and confirmed flow restored. :thumbsup: 
Chris M.: I'll open a bug and revert the positional->named optimization. Workaround in runtime: fall back to schema-based mapping when ambiguity detected.
Emily (Eng Runtime): I'll own the roll-forward patch. Plan: add stronger token-boundary heuristics + unit test that fuzzes arg orders. Target patch for 2025-11-13 04:00Z.
Alex R.: Add an alert rule to catch sudden spike in 'fn_mismatch' errors per-tenant.
Jordan (Support): Thanks everyone. Customer is updated. Will follow up after patch.
Emily (Eng Runtime): FYI I'll link PR and postmortem once done. :eyes:
